Let $G$, $T$, $P$, $\lambda$ be as in the paper, let $S$ and $t$ be as in the paper, let $Y_S=\{v\in W^P:\ B^S\cdot vP/P=vP/P\}$, and for $v\in Y_S$ let $X_P^t(v)$ be the connected component of $X_P^t$ indexed by $v$. Let $R_P^+$ be the set of roots of the unipotent radical of $P$, $\mathrm{td}$ the Todd genus of the tangent bundle, and for $n\geq 0$ let $V(n\lambda)$ be the representation of the paper. Then, for every integer $n\geq 0$,
\[
\mathrm{ch}\bigl(t^{-1},V(n\lambda)\bigr)=\sum_{v\in Y_S} D_v^t(n,\lambda),
\]
where
\[
D_v^t(n,\lambda)=\sum_{k\geq 0}\int_{X_P^t(v)}\frac{c_1\bigl(\mathcal{L}(\lambda)|_{X_P^t(v)}\bigr)^k\,\frac{n^k}{k!}\,e^{-nv\lambda}(t)\cdot\mathrm{td}(X_P^t(v))}{\prod_{\alpha\in (vR_P^+)\setminus R((G^t)^o)}\bigl[1-e^\alpha(t)\,e^{-c_1(\overline{\mathcal{L}}(\alpha)|_{X_P^t(v)})}\bigr]}.
